name: Quantum Entanglement Semantic Obfuscation
description: Replaces standard networking and graph-theoretic terminology with quantum subsystem entanglement concepts. By removing the explicit mention of a "unique route" (which signals a tree) and instead stating that $m = n - 1$ operations provide complete state integration, models must deduce that the underlying structure is a tree and apply the correct minimal subtree extraction without relying on direct keyword triggers.
